name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began in the dusty karting tracks of Santiago, where he honed his mechanical skills and a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. He quickly transitioned into Formula 3 Sudamericana, working his way up from junior mechanic to race engineer within a few seasons. His strategic thinking and ability to remain composed under pressure caught the eye of several international teams, eventually leading him to a role overseeing logistics and race operations for a smaller European outfit.

Ricardo is known for his calm and methodical approach to race management. He excels at identifying potential bottlenecks and proactively implementing solutions. His focus is on optimizing team resources and ensuring seamless coordination between engineering, pit crew, and drivers. He believes that a well-organized and supportive environment is crucial for maximizing performance on the track. At United Autosports, Ricardo aims to bring his experience to bear, ensuring the team is always prepared and operating at peak efficiency.

What sets Ricardo apart is his inherent ability to see the big picture without losing sight of the minute details. He's a master of contingency planning, always prepared with backup strategies to navigate unexpected challenges. This, combined with his calm demeanor, makes him a valuable asset in the high-pressure environment of motorsport.

physical.description: A man of medium build with a thoughtful expression and a slight tan.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office
Insists on a pre-race team huddle with a motivational quote
